/locations.title: Find the right local guide when the mailing address is unclear
paragraphs: A business address, a freeway exit and the exact point of impact can suggest different places. Find the nearest cross street, direction of travel and any incident number before choosing a city guide. The agency listed on the paperwork is useful when you need a copy of its report. If you are deciding where to consult, use the office information separately from the location of the incident.
/locations.linkLabel: See Buena Park office and collision resources

/locations/buena-park.title: Separate the storefront from the shared walkway
paragraphs: For a fall near a Beach Boulevard business, sketch the route from the door you used to the exact spot. Mark whether you were on the store’s entry pad, a shared walkway or the parking aisle. A receipt can place you there in time. A wider photograph can help identify whose staff or cameras may have covered that stretch.

If the incident involved a vehicle as well as a shopping-center walkway, keep the driving route and walking route on one sketch. Mark the entrance, the point of contact and where you spoke with staff. An address on Beach Boulevard may identify several businesses, so retain a receipt or storefront photograph that narrows the location.

When contacting the Buena Park office, identify the immediate question: obtaining a report, responding to an insurer, or arranging records for a family member. You can bring what you have and identify what is still missing. Ask which documents would help with that decision before sending a full medical file.
/locations/buena-park.linkLabel: See which records matter after a fall

links.label: How to organize a general personal injury claim
Read the related car accident service guide

/locations/anaheim.title: Document a changed rideshare pickup
paragraphs: If a pickup was moved from a hotel entrance to a different curb, save the in-app messages and both location pins. Write down when the instruction came through and where you were when the injury occurred. That timeline can distinguish an incident inside a property from an event that took place as passengers were boarding a vehicle.

A hotel receipt, trip receipt and attraction ticket may show different parts of the same visit. Keep the timestamps and identify the specific curb, doorway or crossing involved in the injury. If someone changed the pickup instructions, save the original message as well as the revised location.

If you returned home outside Anaheim after the incident, keep later treatment records in the same dated chronology. Identify the provider and the concern addressed at each visit. Your current address and the incident location serve different purposes when explaining what happened.
/locations/anaheim.linkLabel: See how rideshare records fit into a claim

links.label: Separate the trip record from the collision and coverage questions
Read the related rideshare accident service guide

/locations/fullerton.title: Identify the rail crossing or station entrance precisely
paragraphs: If an incident happened near a Fullerton station, record whether you were in a parking aisle, a street crossing or an area reached through an entrance. Save any parking ticket or ride receipt with the time shown. This makes it easier to ask the right property manager or agency for information about a particular corner or path.

When a pedestrian route passes a station, garage or campus entrance, identify the boundary between the street and the property. Preserve signs, the entrance used and any ticket that anchors the time. Keep a description of the surface or vehicle movement separate from assumptions about who operated that part of the route.

If you missed shifts or classes after the injury, keep the original schedule and document what changed. For irregular work, a short explanation of the ordinary pattern can help someone understand the records. The consultation can then separate the collision evidence from the treatment and income questions.
/locations/fullerton.linkLabel: See what to document after a pedestrian injury

links.label: Which records support lost-income and injury questions
Read the related pedestrian accident service guide

/locations/garden-grove.title: Identify which business could see a turning lane
paragraphs: For a collision by a shopping-center driveway, record which driveway the vehicle used and whether it was entering or exiting. A photo from the street side can show which businesses face that lane. If you ask about video, provide the intersection or driveway, direction and time range so the business can identify the relevant camera.

Keep a copy of each request for driveway or intersection video, including the time range you supplied and the person who responded. If a business can provide only a short clip, record what period is missing. A lack of footage from one camera does not establish that no other recording or witness exists.

If your car was moved before you could take scene photographs, keep the tow information and any earlier pictures from another occupant. Tell the office which images show the original positions and which show the vehicles after they were moved. That distinction helps focus a Garden Grove consultation on the evidence that can actually be checked.
/locations/garden-grove.linkLabel: See how a car crash is investigated

links.label: Evidence when a collision report is unavailable
Read the related car accident service guide

/locations/cypress.title: Save the route from a campus or business parking lot
paragraphs: A parking-lot collision can be described as happening at the same address even when the drivers used different entrances. Mark each approach and the stall or aisle where the contact occurred. Save any visitor check-in or receipt to help confirm the time. Ask the property office who handled the incident and how to request its reference number.

For an incident involving a work or delivery vehicle, preserve both the driver’s details and the vehicle identifiers already available to you. Record what the vehicle appeared to be doing without assuming an employment relationship from a logo alone. Keep any later company response with the original scene information.

If a parking-lot camera is identified, supply the aisle, direction and time range rather than only the business address. Save the response, including a statement that footage could not be located. That makes the remaining evidence gap clear during a consultation.

links.label: Identify commercial-vehicle records without guessing who holds them
Read the related truck accident service guide

/locations/la-habra.title: Record the direction of travel at an angled turn
paragraphs: For a crash at a driveway or offset intersection, write down the road each vehicle came from and where it was trying to turn. Photograph the lane arrows and sight lines if you can do so safely. That detail helps a reviewer distinguish a disagreement about the turn from a disagreement about where the first impact happened.

A photograph taken after traffic cleared may show a different view from the one available before impact. Label when each picture was taken and describe any parked vehicles or temporary obstruction you actually remember. Keep that description separate from later assumptions about visibility.

If the disagreement concerns a turning vehicle, organize the original statements and images before responding to a fault percentage. Identify which movement remains disputed and what record might clarify it. Treatment and work restrictions belong in a separate part of the same injury file.
/locations/la-habra.linkLabel: See why each driver’s actions matter

links.label: How to organize a dispute about each person’s responsibility
Read the related car accident service guide

/locations/la-mirada.title: Use the incident location to find the investigating agency
paragraphs: If an incident happened near a city or county boundary, save the exact street, nearest cross street and travel direction. The agency name on a crash exchange card or report request can help establish who investigated. Keep the agency reference separate from the insurance claim number so a callback goes to the right office.

When a report request is redirected, keep the first agency’s response and any new reference number. Record the precise incident location on each request, including the direction of travel if it was a collision. A mailing address or nearby landmark does not replace the event location recorded by the investigating agency.

If a report arrives with an entry you dispute, preserve the original and identify the specific line. Keep the supporting photograph, diagram or witness information beside it. An insurance review and an agency correction request can remain separate tasks.
/locations/la-mirada.linkLabel: Read how to keep crash reports separate

links.label: Preparing a focused request to correct a collision report
Read the related car accident service guide

/locations/cerritos.title: Record where the car was when a lot is shared
paragraphs: When several businesses use the same lot, record the row, nearby entrance and nearest driveway. Note whether the vehicle was parked, backing out or moving along an aisle. A timestamped receipt can help narrow the time range for staff looking for video. Ask which business or manager controls any camera that faces the relevant row.

For a collision in a shared parking lot, note whether the other vehicle was parked, reversing or passing through the aisle. Keep any company or delivery markings you safely recorded. An employee who accepts an incident report may not control the camera or the lot, so record the role of each person you contacted.

If an insurer later describes a different row or entrance, keep that explanation with your original sketch and photographs. Ask which location is being reviewed before gathering more material. This avoids sending useful evidence for the wrong part of a Cerritos property.
/locations/cerritos.linkLabel: Read how vehicle and scene evidence fit together

links.label: What to keep when damage is discovered on a parked vehicle
Read the related car accident service guide

/locations/norwalk.title: Keep the lane history when a freeway backup reaches an exit
paragraphs: Record the freeway, direction, exit and lane where you were just before impact. If you felt more than one impact, write down the order you remember and what you saw before each. Save the full dashcam sequence if available. A final image of the damaged cars cannot show how traffic slowed or who moved between lanes.

For a multi-vehicle collision, label each vehicle consistently in your notes and save any exchange card in its original form. Record which impact you felt first without guessing about a movement you could not see. Keep the time the vehicles were moved separate from the collision time.

A conversation about a Norwalk injury can begin with the report reference, scene location and the next insurer request. Keep vehicle repair paperwork separate from medical correspondence so a property payment is not mistaken for a decision about the injury.
/locations/norwalk.linkLabel: See what to keep after a collision

links.label: Build a collision file that separates facts and missing information
Read the related truck accident service guide

/locations/whittier.title: Match a pedestrian report to the correct corner
paragraphs: Copy the street names and the corner you were crossing from. Add whether you were heading toward a driveway, bus stop or marked crosswalk. Save a map pin with any witness details, and record which direction the approaching vehicle was moving. A useful account lets someone else follow the same route you walked.

For a walking route affected by a slope, parked vehicles or an angled crossing, preserve a wider view from a safe position. Identify the direction the pedestrian and driver approached from. A close-up of the impact point can leave those earlier sight lines unexplained.

Keep the agency named on the incident paperwork with any request for a report. If a later letter uses a different location, retain both versions and identify where they differ. A consultation can then focus on whether the issue is an address, a route description or a disputed account of the collision.
/locations/whittier.linkLabel: See which records can clarify a pedestrian collision

links.label: Compare an inaccurate report entry with the supporting evidence
Read the related pedestrian accident service guide

/locations/costa-mesa.title: Identify the pickup door at a venue
paragraphs: At a venue with more than one loading area, the event name alone may be too broad. Keep the ticket, the message naming the entrance and the timestamp of a pickup change. Add a simple map pin where the event occurred. These records can help match the incident to a specific curb or vehicle rather than the venue as a whole.

If a pickup or loading location changed during an event, retain the instructions in the order received. Record who sent each instruction and when you moved. Keep the exact injury location distinct from the venue’s main entrance or the address on an admission ticket.

When an incident involves both a vehicle and a property condition, explain each part without deciding in advance which person is responsible. A trip record, premises report and witness account may answer different questions. Bring the records already available and identify any request still pending.
/locations/costa-mesa.linkLabel: See what a rideshare trip record can show

links.label: Separate the event, responsible parties and available records
Read the related rideshare accident service guide

/locations/irvine.title: Use the building and level to identify a garage incident
paragraphs: Record the structure’s address, level, entrance and closest stairwell or elevator. If an incident occurred on a ramp, note which direction each person was moving. A ticket, gate record or receipt can anchor the time. Ask who manages the structure before assuming a nearby business has responsibility for its maintenance or cameras.

For a garage or office-property incident, record any stall, building or access identifier that distinguishes the location from nearby structures. Keep the gate receipt or visitor record if available. If maintenance or security staff responded, note their role and the incident reference.

If a surface condition changed before a photograph could be taken, describe what you observed and who else saw it. Preserve any message about the condition or repair. Keep an eyewitness description separate from a conclusion about who maintained the area or how long a hazard existed.
/locations/irvine.linkLabel: Read how property control can affect a fall claim

links.label: Organize maintenance, notice and injury questions after a fall
Read the related slip and fall service guide

/locations/long-beach.title: Document a bicycle route through a traffic circle
paragraphs: Identify the entry street, the exit you intended to use and the lane at the point of contact. Save a longer ride recording or tracked route if you have one. A full route helps distinguish where a driver joined the circle from where either person was leaving. Record what you observed yourself and who supplied any other details.

For a bicycle collision, keep the bicycle, riding equipment and original recording available for discussion before repair or disposal. A short exported clip may omit the approach, so preserve the full file when possible. Note any interruption in a tracked route or recording.

A repair estimate and a medical record answer different questions. Keep both with the date of the event, but separate replacement costs from treatment, missed work and transportation changes. That gives the first conversation a clear starting point even if the liability investigation is incomplete.
/locations/long-beach.linkLabel: Read what to preserve after a bicycle collision

links.label: Questions about bicycle evidence and insurance
Read the related bicycle accident service guide

/locations/los-angeles.title: Find the right records when a commercial vehicle was involved
paragraphs: Save any identifying plate or company information already on the report or photos. Note whether the vehicle appeared to be making a stop or moving through the area, and describe where it was positioned. Keep that observation separate from what you have verified about the driver’s employer or the vehicle owner.

For a delivery or fleet-vehicle collision, keep the plate, unit number and company name exactly as they appear in the material you already have. If another business contacts you later, preserve the message identifying its role. The vehicle owner, driver’s employer and insurer may require separate identification.

Record the exact scene and the agency that responded rather than relying on Los Angeles as a broad location label. If there were several stops or impacts, distinguish the collision location from where the vehicle was later parked, inspected or towed.
/locations/los-angeles.linkLabel: See what can identify a commercial vehicle and its operator

links.label: Identifying the vehicle, operator and records after a truck crash
Read the related truck accident service guide

/locations/huntington-beach.title: Pin down where a bike route meets traffic
paragraphs: A path crossing, driveway and street corner can be close together but offer different views of traffic. Record the type of crossing you used and where a driver was turning. Save any recording leading up to contact so a reviewer can see how both people approached. Keep copies of any messages that change your understanding of the location.

For a collision near a path or driveway, record where the bicycle or pedestrian route entered the area used by vehicles. Preserve the whole approach if a video exists. A photograph of a marked route does not show by itself how the two people moved immediately before contact.

Keep any repair inspection with dated photographs of the bicycle and equipment. For an injury consultation, add the treatment timeline and practical changes to commuting or work. Identify which details you observed yourself and which came from a witness or later message.
/locations/huntington-beach.linkLabel: Read questions about evidence after a bicycle crash

links.label: Prepare the route, equipment and injury record for a bicycle claim
Read the related bicycle accident service guide

/locations/newport-beach.title: Follow the route from a parking area to the waterfront
paragraphs: For a fall or pedestrian injury, record the parking level or aisle, the doorway or ramp you used, and the exact place of contact. Separate what happened in a vehicle area from what happened on a walkway. A location sketch can show which property or traffic feature needs attention even when the entire visit was described under one address.

If the route crossed a parking structure, a ramp and an outdoor walkway, mark each transition on the same sketch. Preserve a receipt or access record that helps establish the time. Record which staff member responded and whether the reference concerns the property incident or a traffic collision.

For a pedestrian injury, the route before contact may matter as much as the final location. Keep wider photographs and witness information alongside medical records and work restrictions. Describe the specific question you want reviewed instead of treating the shared street address as a complete explanation.
/locations/newport-beach.linkLabel: See how to document a walking route and point of impact

links.label: Document a pedestrian route and the effects of an injury
Read the related pedestrian accident service guide

/es/locations.title: Busque la guía local por el punto exacto del incidente
paragraphs: Un domicilio comercial y una salida de autopista pueden indicar lugares distintos del punto del impacto. Anote el cruce, el sentido de viaje y el número del informe antes de elegir una guía. Si necesita una copia del informe, empiece por la agencia identificada en sus documentos.
/es/locations.linkLabel: Vea los recursos locales de Buena Park

/ko/locations.title: 사고 지점을 기준으로 지역 안내를 찾으세요
paragraphs: 사업장 주소나 고속도로 출구 이름이 실제 충돌 지점과 다를 수 있습니다. 도시 안내를 고르기 전에 가까운 교차로, 진행 방향, 보고서 번호를 확인하세요. 보고서 사본은 서류에 적힌 조사 기관부터 문의하면 됩니다.

/es/locations/buena-park.title: Distinga la entrada de la tienda del paso común
paragraphs: Si se cayó cerca de un comercio en Beach Boulevard, dibuje el trayecto desde la puerta hasta el punto exacto. Señale si estaba en la entrada, un paso común o un carril del estacionamiento. Guarde un recibo y una fotografía amplia para ubicar la hora y el lugar.
/es/locations/buena-park.linkLabel: Vea qué registros importan después de una caída

/ko/locations/buena-park.title: 매장 입구와 공용 통로를 구분하세요
paragraphs: 비치 블러바드 상점 근처에서 넘어졌다면 이용한 문에서 사고 지점까지 이동 경로를 그려 보세요. 매장 입구, 공용 통로, 주차장 통행로 중 어디였는지 표시하세요. 영수증과 넓게 찍은 사진은 시간과 위치를 확인하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

/es/locations/anaheim.title: Documente un cambio en el punto de recogida
paragraphs: Si la recogida se trasladó de la entrada de un hotel a otra acera, guarde los mensajes y las dos ubicaciones en el mapa. Anote cuándo llegó la instrucción y dónde estaba usted cuando ocurrió la lesión. Esos datos ayudan a reconstruir la secuencia antes de subir al vehículo.
/es/locations/anaheim.linkLabel: Vea cómo se usan los registros del viaje

/ko/locations/anaheim.title: 탑승 장소가 바뀌었다면 기록을 남기세요
paragraphs: 호텔 입구에서 다른 연석으로 탑승 위치가 바뀌었다면 앱 메시지와 지도에 표시된 두 지점을 보관하세요. 변경 안내를 받은 시각과 다친 위치를 적어 두면 차량에 탑승하기 전 경위를 재구성하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
/ko/locations/anaheim.linkLabel: 승차공유 운행 기록이 청구에 쓰이는 방식 보기

/es/locations/fullerton.title: Identifique el cruce o la entrada de la estación
paragraphs: Si el incidente ocurrió cerca de una estación en Fullerton, anote si estaba en un estacionamiento, en un cruce o dentro de una entrada. Guarde un boleto o recibo con la hora. Estos datos ayudan a pedir el registro correcto a la agencia o al administrador del lugar.
/es/locations/fullerton.linkLabel: Vea qué documentar tras una lesión peatonal (en inglés)

/ko/locations/fullerton.title: 역 주변 사고라면 횡단 지점이나 출입구를 확인하세요
paragraphs: 풀러턴 역 근처에서 사고가 났다면 주차장 통행로, 도로 횡단 지점, 역 출입구 중 어디였는지 적어 두세요. 시간이 표시된 주차권이나 영수증을 보관하면 조사 기관이나 시설 관리인에게 필요한 기록을 구체적으로 문의할 수 있습니다.
/ko/locations/fullerton.linkLabel: 보행자 사고 뒤 기록할 내용 보기 (영어)

/es/locations/garden-grove.title: Identifique qué comercio podía ver el giro
paragraphs: En un choque junto a un centro comercial, anote qué acceso usó el vehículo y si entraba o salía. Una foto amplia puede mostrar qué comercios dan a ese carril. Al preguntar por un video, indique el acceso, el sentido y un intervalo de tiempo.
/es/locations/garden-grove.linkLabel: Vea cómo se investiga un choque

/ko/locations/garden-grove.title: 회전 차로를 볼 수 있는 사업장을 확인하세요
paragraphs: 상가 진입로에서 충돌했다면 차량이 이용한 진입로와 들어가던 중이었는지 나오던 중이었는지 적으세요. 넓은 사진은 어느 매장이 해당 차로를 향하고 있는지 보여 줍니다. 영상에 대해 문의할 때는 진입로, 진행 방향, 시간대를 알려 주세요.

/es/locations/cypress.title: Trace el recorrido por el estacionamiento
paragraphs: Dos vehículos pueden compartir la misma dirección y haber usado entradas distintas. Marque el acceso y el carril o puesto donde ocurrió el contacto. Guarde un recibo o registro de entrada con la hora. Pregunte a la administración quién recibió el informe y cuál fue su referencia.
/es/locations/cypress.linkLabel: Lea qué conservar después de un choque

/ko/locations/cypress.title: 주차장 안의 이동 경로를 표시하세요
paragraphs: 주소가 같더라도 차량마다 이용한 입구가 다를 수 있습니다. 각 차량이 지나온 입구와 충돌한 통행로나 주차 칸을 표시하세요. 시간 확인에 도움이 되는 방문 기록이나 영수증을 보관하고 관리 사무실에 누가 접수했는지, 접수 번호가 있는지도 물어보세요.

/es/locations/la-habra.title: Anote el sentido de marcha antes del giro
paragraphs: En un choque cerca de un acceso o cruce irregular, indique de qué calle venía cada vehículo y hacia dónde intentaba girar. Si puede hacerlo de forma segura, fotografíe las flechas del carril y la visibilidad. Eso aclara qué parte de la maniobra se discute.
/es/locations/la-habra.linkLabel: Vea por qué importan las acciones de ambos conductores

/ko/locations/la-habra.title: 회전하기 전 진행 방향을 적으세요
paragraphs: 진입로나 어긋난 교차로에서 사고가 났다면 각 차량이 어느 도로에서 와서 어느 방향으로 돌려고 했는지 적으세요. 안전하다면 차로 화살표와 시야가 드러나는 사진을 보관하세요. 어느 움직임을 두고 진술이 엇갈리는지 파악하기 쉽습니다.
/ko/locations/la-habra.linkLabel: 두 운전자의 행동이 과실 판단에 미치는 영향 보기

/es/locations/la-mirada.title: Identifique quién investigó por el sitio exacto
paragraphs: Si el incidente ocurrió cerca de un límite municipal, anote la calle, el cruce más cercano y el sentido de viaje. Busque el nombre de la agencia en la tarjeta o el informe. Conserve la referencia de esa agencia por separado del número del seguro.
/es/locations/la-mirada.linkLabel: Lea cómo distinguir los informes de un choque (en inglés)

/ko/locations/la-mirada.title: 정확한 사고 지점과 조사 기관을 확인하세요
paragraphs: 도시 경계 근처에서 사고가 났다면 정확한 도로명, 가까운 교차로, 진행 방향을 기록하세요. 정보 교환 카드나 보고서에서 조사 기관을 확인하고 그 기관의 접수 번호를 보험 청구 번호와 따로 보관하세요.
/ko/locations/la-mirada.linkLabel: 충돌 관련 보고서를 구분하는 방법 보기 (영어)

/es/locations/cerritos.title: Ubique el vehículo dentro de un estacionamiento compartido
paragraphs: Anote la fila, la entrada más cercana y si el vehículo estaba estacionado, retrocedía o circulaba por un carril. Un recibo puede acotar la hora. Pregunte quién controla la cámara que da a esa fila antes de enviar la solicitud a un comercio.
/es/locations/cerritos.linkLabel: Lea cómo se usan las pruebas del vehículo y del lugar

/ko/locations/cerritos.title: 공용 주차장에서 차량 위치를 정확히 적으세요
paragraphs: 주차 구역과 가까운 출입구를 표시하고 차량이 주차 중이었는지, 후진 중이었는지, 통행로를 달리고 있었는지 적으세요. 영수증으로 시간대를 좁힐 수 있습니다. 영상을 요청하기 전에 해당 구역을 비추는 카메라를 누가 관리하는지 확인하세요.
/ko/locations/cerritos.linkLabel: 차량과 현장 증거가 쓰이는 방식 보기

/es/locations/norwalk.title: Conserve la secuencia cuando el tráfico se detuvo cerca de una salida
paragraphs: Anote la autopista, la salida, el sentido y el carril. Si sintió más de un impacto, registre el orden que recuerda y qué vio antes de cada uno. Guarde el video completo si existe, con los segundos en que comenzaron a frenar los vehículos.
/es/locations/norwalk.linkLabel: Vea qué guardar después de una colisión

/ko/locations/norwalk.title: 출구 근처 정체에서 충돌 전후 순서를 남기세요
paragraphs: 고속도로 이름과 출구, 진행 방향, 차로를 적으세요. 충격을 여러 번 느꼈다면 기억나는 순서와 각 충격 전에 본 것을 기록하세요. 영상이 있다면 차량들이 감속하기 시작한 시점부터 전체 파일을 보관하세요.

/es/locations/whittier.title: Ubique el punto de partida de un cruce peatonal
paragraphs: Anote los nombres de las calles y la esquina desde la que salió. Indique si iba hacia un cruce marcado, una parada o un acceso. Guarde un punto en el mapa con la información de testigos y el sentido del vehículo que se acercaba.
/es/locations/whittier.linkLabel: Vea qué puede aclarar una colisión peatonal

/ko/locations/whittier.title: 보행자가 출발한 모퉁이를 확인하세요
paragraphs: 도로명과 출발한 모퉁이를 적고, 표시된 횡단보도나 정류장, 진입로 중 어디로 향했는지 표시하세요. 지도 위치와 함께 목격자 연락처와 차량이 접근한 방향도 기록해 두세요.
/ko/locations/whittier.linkLabel: 보행자 충돌 경위를 설명할 자료 보기

/es/locations/costa-mesa.title: Identifique la puerta exacta de recogida
paragraphs: Si un recinto tiene más de una zona de carga, guarde el boleto y el mensaje que identifica la entrada. Anote la hora de cualquier cambio y marque el lugar del incidente. Así puede vincular los registros a una acera concreta del recinto.
/es/locations/costa-mesa.linkLabel: Vea qué puede mostrar un registro de viaje

/ko/locations/costa-mesa.title: 행사장의 정확한 탑승 출입구를 확인하세요
paragraphs: 행사장에 승하차 구역이 여러 곳이라면 입장권과 출입구를 지정한 메시지를 보관하세요. 위치가 바뀐 시각과 사고가 난 곳을 표시해 두면 운행 기록이 행사장의 어느 연석과 관련된 것인지 알 수 있습니다.
/ko/locations/costa-mesa.linkLabel: 승차공유 기록으로 확인할 수 있는 내용 보기

/es/locations/irvine.title: Ubique el incidente por edificio y nivel
paragraphs: Anote el domicilio, el nivel, la entrada y la escalera o ascensor más cercano. Si ocurrió en una rampa, indique en qué dirección se movía cada persona. Un boleto o recibo ayuda a fijar la hora. Pregunte quién administra el estacionamiento.
/es/locations/irvine.linkLabel: Lea cómo influye el control de una propiedad

/ko/locations/irvine.title: 주차 시설의 건물과 층수를 기록하세요
paragraphs: 주차장 주소, 층, 입구, 가장 가까운 계단이나 엘리베이터를 적으세요. 경사로에서 사고가 났다면 각 사람이 이동하던 방향도 표시하세요. 주차권이나 영수증으로 시간을 확인하고 어느 곳에서 시설을 관리하는지 문의하세요.
/ko/locations/irvine.linkLabel: 시설 관리 주체가 낙상 청구에 미치는 영향 보기

/es/locations/long-beach.title: Documente la ruta en bicicleta por una glorieta
paragraphs: Identifique la calle de entrada, la salida que pensaba usar y el carril del impacto. Guarde el recorrido o video completo si lo tiene. Anote de dónde llegó el otro vehículo y qué detalles observó usted personalmente. La secuencia ayuda a ubicar cada movimiento dentro de la glorieta.
/es/locations/long-beach.linkLabel: Lea qué conservar tras un choque de bicicleta (en inglés)

/ko/locations/long-beach.title: 회전교차로에서 자전거 이동 경로를 기록하세요
paragraphs: 진입한 도로, 나가려던 출구, 접촉 당시 차로를 적으세요. 경로 기록이나 전체 영상이 있다면 보관하세요. 상대 차량이 어디에서 들어왔는지와 본인이 직접 본 부분을 구분하면 교차로 안에서 두 이동 경로를 비교하기 쉽습니다.
/ko/locations/long-beach.linkLabel: 자전거 충돌 뒤 보관할 자료 보기 (영어)

/es/locations/los-angeles.title: Ubique los registros de un vehículo comercial
paragraphs: Guarde la placa y el nombre de la empresa que aparezca en el informe o las fotografías. Anote dónde estaba el vehículo y si parecía estar haciendo una parada. Separe esa observación de lo que haya verificado sobre el propietario y el empleador del conductor.
/es/locations/los-angeles.linkLabel: Vea qué datos identifican al vehículo y a su operador

/ko/locations/los-angeles.title: 상업용 차량에 관한 기록을 찾으세요
paragraphs: 보고서나 사진에 있는 차량 번호와 회사 이름을 보관하세요. 차량이 있던 위치와 정차 중으로 보였는지도 적어 두세요. 관찰한 사실과 차량 소유자 또는 운전자 고용주에 대해 확인한 정보는 따로 표시하세요.
/ko/locations/los-angeles.linkLabel: 상업용 차량과 운영자를 확인하는 데 필요한 자료 보기

/es/locations/huntington-beach.title: Identifique dónde se cruzó la ruta ciclista con el tráfico
paragraphs: Anote si usaba un cruce de ciclovía, un acceso o una esquina. Señale dónde giraba el vehículo y guarde el tramo del video anterior al contacto. Si alguien le dio una ubicación distinta después, conserve el mensaje con la fecha y la fuente.
/es/locations/huntington-beach.linkLabel: Lea qué pruebas ayudan tras un choque de bicicleta (en inglés)

/ko/locations/huntington-beach.title: 자전거길이 차량 통행로와 만나는 지점을 표시하세요
paragraphs: 자전거길 횡단 지점, 차량 진입로, 도로 모퉁이 중 어디를 지나고 있었는지 적으세요. 차량이 돌던 위치도 표시하고 접촉 전 영상이 있으면 보관하세요. 이후 다른 위치를 전달받았다면 메시지와 날짜, 출처를 남기세요.
/ko/locations/huntington-beach.linkLabel: 자전거 충돌 뒤 도움이 되는 증거 보기 (영어)

/es/locations/newport-beach.title: Trace el camino del estacionamiento al paseo costero
paragraphs: Anote el nivel o carril del estacionamiento, la puerta o rampa que utilizó y el punto del incidente. Indique si ocurrió en un área de vehículos o en un paso peatonal. Un croquis ayuda a distinguir esos espacios aunque compartan la misma dirección.
/es/locations/newport-beach.linkLabel: Vea cómo documentar el recorrido peatonal

/ko/locations/newport-beach.title: 주차장에서 물가까지 걸은 경로를 그려 보세요
paragraphs: 주차 층이나 통행로, 이용한 문이나 경사로, 사고 지점을 차례로 적으세요. 차량 통행 구역에서 일어났는지 보행 통로에서 일어났는지도 표시하세요. 간단한 그림으로 같은 주소에 있는 서로 다른 구역을 설명할 수 있습니다.
/ko/locations/newport-beach.linkLabel: 보행 경로와 충돌 지점 기록 방법 보기
